title: FBI Photo B8
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military sensor system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as part of a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: Heavy redaction: the original imagery was altered with redactions before submission, limiting independent analysis.
No mission report was provided, removing operational context for the sighting.
The date/time stamp in the image is unreliable as the system clock was not correctly set.
The extracted text from the PDF is largely garbled/unintelligible, likely due to OCR artifacts on a heavily redacted or degraded image.
Single-source observation with no corroborating sensor data or witness accounts provided.
The narrative description explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment or factual determination.

verifiable_claims.claim: The FBI submitted this UAP image report to AARO.
